title: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.12823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents increasingly browse, interpret, and act on web content on behalf of users. In many realistic workflows, however, the visual evidence they consume is not neutral: charts and dashboards can be misleading, shaping judgments without issuing any explicit malicious instruction. Unlike chart question answering, Web Agents treat charts as intermediate evidence whose misinterpretation can propagate into concrete downstream actions --- a reliability risk that remains underexplored. We introduce MisVisAgentBench, the first paired executable benchmark for evaluating how misleading visualizations affect Web Agent execution. It comprises 280 task instances in matched clean--misleading pairs that differ only in chart evidence. We further provide a diagnostic framework that isolates misleading-induced failures from baseline task difficulty (Zhu et al., 2025) and captures execution-level effects such as extra browsing steps and decision hesita

translated_title: 当图表欺骗网页智能体：一个面向误导性可视化基础任务的成对基准
translated_abstract: 网页智能体越来越多地代表用户浏览、解读并基于网页内容执行操作。然而在许多现实工作流程中，它们所获取的视觉证据并非中立的：图表和仪表板可能具有误导性，无需发出任何明确的恶意指令就能左右判断。与图表问答不同，网页智能体将图表视为中间证据，对图表的误读可能会传播并转化为具体的下游行动——这一可靠性风险至今仍缺乏充分研究。我们提出了MisVisAgentBench，这是首个用于评估误导性可视化如何影响网页智能体执行的成对可执行基准。该基准包含280个任务实例，以匹配的“干净-误导”成对形式呈现，两者仅在图表证据上存在差异。我们进一步提供了一个诊断框架，将误导性引发的失败与基线任务难度（Zhu et al., 2025）分离开来，并捕捉执行层面的影响，例如额外的浏览步骤和决策犹豫。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个成对可执行基准MisVisAgentBench，通过280个仅图表证据不同的“干净-误导”匹配任务对，评估误导性可视化对网页智能体下游执行行为的影响，并提供诊断框架将误导引发的失败与基线任务难度区分开来。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MisVisAgentBench, the first paired executable benchmark with 280 matched clean-misleading task pairs differing only in chart evidence, to evaluate how misleading visualizations propagate into Web Agent downstream execution failures, along with a diagnostic framework that isolates misleading-induced failures from baseline task difficulty.
